t: The Segfault and the Shell: A Case Study in Debugging Your Dev Environment
s: This case study details debugging a 'segmentation fault' in a Nix-managed Python development environment. It highlights the tension between Nix's reproducibility and the flexibility needed for data science, culminating in a method to compare working and broken virtual environments to isolate dependency issues.
sub: Nix dev environment configuration for reproducibility vs. flexibility
Debugging segmentation faults in Python/C extensions
Isolating broken Python virtual environment dependencies via .venv comparison
CI/CD and AI tool limitations in pinpointing binary dependency errors
